name: Generic Document Intelligence
description: Universal document extraction — works with any document type. Automatically identifies and extracts key metadata, entities, dates, amounts, and compliance information.

fields.name: document_title
fields.label: Document Title
fields.description: Main title or heading of the document

fields.name: document_number
fields.label: Document Number / Reference
fields.description: Official document reference, ID, or tracking number

fields.name: revision
fields.label: Revision / Version
fields.description: Document version or revision number

fields.name: document_date
fields.label: Date
fields.description: Issue date, publication date, or effective date

fields.name: document_type
fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: Type of document (report, contract, specification, plan, policy, etc.)

fields.name: document_status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Document status (draft, review, approved, final, etc.)

fields.name: language
fields.label: Language
fields.description: Primary language of the document

fields.name: author
fields.label: Author / Prepared By
fields.description: Person or organization that authored the document

fields.name: reviewer
fields.label: Reviewer / Checked By
fields.description: Person who reviewed or checked the document

fields.name: approver
fields.label: Approver / Authorized By
fields.description: Person who approved or authorized the document

fields.name: recipient
fields.label: Recipient / Addressed To
fields.description: Intended recipient, client, or addressee

fields.name: organization
fields.label: Issuing Organization
fields.description: Company or organization that issued the document

fields.name: other_parties
fields.label: Other Parties Mentioned
fields.description: All other organizations, companies, or entities mentioned

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Executive Summary
fields.description: Brief summary or abstract of the document content

fields.name: scope
fields.label: Scope / Purpose
fields.description: Stated scope, purpose, or objective of the document

fields.name: key_findings
fields.label: Key Findings / Conclusions
fields.description: Main findings, conclusions, or outcomes

fields.name: action_items
fields.label: Action Items / Next Steps
fields.description: Required actions, recommendations, or next steps

fields.name: section_headings
fields.label: Section Headings
fields.description: All major section headings in order

fields.name: key_dates
fields.label: Key Dates
fields.description: All significant dates mentioned (deadlines, milestones, effective dates)

fields.name: monetary_amounts
fields.label: Monetary Amounts
fields.description: All financial figures, costs, prices, or budgets mentioned

fields.name: quantities
fields.label: Quantities / Measurements
fields.description: All numerical quantities, measurements, or specifications

fields.name: durations
fields.label: Durations / Timeframes
fields.description: Time periods, durations, or schedules mentioned

fields.name: standards_referenced
fields.label: Standards / Regulations
fields.description: All standards, regulations, codes, or laws referenced

fields.name: related_documents
fields.label: Related Documents
fields.description: Other documents, drawings, or attachments referenced

fields.name: appendices
fields.label: Appendices / Attachments
fields.description: Listed appendices, annexes, or attachments

fields.name: risks_identified
fields.label: Risks Identified
fields.description: Any risks, hazards, or concerns mentioned

fields.name: compliance_requirements
fields.label: Compliance Requirements
fields.description: Regulatory or compliance requirements stated

fields.name: terms_conditions
fields.label: Key Terms / Conditions
fields.description: Important terms, conditions, caveats, or limitations
